notes.title: Trading plan
notes.content:
Trading plan

 

Goals 

  • R = $100-200 for Topstep 

  • Focus on futures and day trading only. Until you are consistent.

  • Funded accounts with 50k each buying power with 2k totally draw down.

  • Main Goal: Achieve 10 Rs per month, with a focus on maintaining consistency and discipline.

  • Win Rate: Target at least a 50% win rate with 10-20% break-even trades, and the remainder as full losses.

  • Max Losses:

    • Daily: Maximum loss of 2 Rs per day.

    • Weekly: Maximum loss of 6 Rs per week.

    • Monthly: Maximum loss of 10 Rs per month.

  • Max Gains: Aim for a maximum gain of 30 Rs per month.

Day Trading

1. Trade Execution Rules:

  • Trade Timing:

    • No trading after 2:00 PM.

  • Stop Loss Management:

    • Take the risk out as soon as you get the opportunity or at first profit level.

    • Take profit all the way up to 100point on NQ and 20 points on ES/RTY

    • Leave the runners 1 contract.

2. Emotional and Physical State:

  • No Trading If:

    • You are tired, sick, emotionally compromised, or haven't had enough sleep.

  • Post-Trade Routine:

    • After every win or loss, take a walk to reset.

    • Journal the trade before taking another.

3. Market Analysis & Entry Rules:

  • Gap Analysis:

    • Determine whether the market is in a "retest gap" or "gap and go" scenario. Use this to decide the appropriate trading strategy.

  • EMA & RSI Use:

    • Check EMA on the 4-hour and 1-hour charts to confirm trend direction.

    • Use RSI to identify overbought or oversold conditions, adding confluence to your decision-making.

  • Volume Profile:

    • Analyze volume profiles to identify key levels such as the developing POC and value areas for potential entry and exit points.

    • Only take trade that is moving with daily volume for example: No buying, if value is moving lower and we are below YPOC( Yesterday Point of Control), vise versa.

    • Don’t take more than 2 tries for same play.

    • If you playing open, 2 full stop and you are done.

Volume Profile Strategies:

 

1.     Open play:

Buy/sell based on open playing value range if its opening above/below YRTH (Yesterday Regular Trading hour high)/YRTL (Yesterday Regular Trading hour low) and targeting next day TF levels. A+ when daily chart suggestive larger move out of range.

Core Idea: The opening play involves trading based on the market's gap up or gap down behavior at the open.

Criteria for A+ Setup:

  1. Assess the type of gap: is it a "gap and go" or a "retest gap"?

  2. Consider the size of the gap and whether there are supply or demand zones above or below the gap.

  3. If there’s a block of volume at the gap, it may be difficult for the price to cross, presenting a fade opportunity.

 

2.     SS break:

Buy/Sell SS break on Daily fixed range volume profile levels, or Session levels. Better if combine both and use OB ( Over Bought )/OS ( Over Sold) RSI for additional confluences. Take profit at developing VA/POC.

Idea: This setup focuses on using time-frame references to predict rejections or extensions at certain levels.

Criteria for A+ Setup:

  1. Look for an "extension into location" where the price moves significantly towards a reference level.

  2. Both rejection and acceptance around these levels can provide trade opportunities.

3.      Look for extension in to previous day VP levels (DPOC DVAH, DVAL) and look to fade a break that doesn’t see immediate follow through.

 

3.     DPOC Pass over: 

Buy/Sell pass over/under DPOC when most likely scenario on lower TF (Time Frame) is HL (higher Low)/LH (Lower High). Targeting developing value.

Core Idea: This setup revolves around the daily point of control (DPOC) or value area levels (VAH/VAL). The main goal is to identify blocks of supply or demand that align with the DPOC or VAH/VAL.

Criteria for A+ Setup:

  • Look for significant supply or demand near these levels.

  • If there is "baby supply" or "baby demand" in the area, you can react to the setup.

Trend day:

 

·       Open play

·       DPOC (Developing Point of control) /DVAH (Developing value area high /DVAL (Developing value area low) PBO (Pass Back Over) or PBU (Pass Back Under).


Balance day:

·       Look for extension in to previous day VP (Volume profile) levels or Developing area, look to fade a break that doesn’t see immediate follow through.

·       Entry Rule for PBO/PBU: Add filter: “Require stair step or pivot confirmation if after 11:30 AM
